cohort: The study enrolled 27,074 pregnant women who underwent cesarean delivery at Women's Hospital of Nanjing Medical University, Nanjing Maternity and Child Health Care Hospital between January 1, 2020, and December 30, 2022.
finding: The incidence of symptomatic VTE following cesarean delivery was significantly lower in the nurse-assisted early warning intervention group (0.29 per 1000 deliveries) compared to the routine nursing care group (2.4 per 1000 deliveries).
